turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have to pick one elective for next term and I've narrowed it down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Psychology of learning, which sounds useful, but everyone says the exam is brutal.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Creative writing, purely coursework, and I'd actually enjoy it a lot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Intro to statistics, which would look great for the jobs I want later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or film studies, where you basically watch movies and write about them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, I think I'm done. Yeah. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How heavy is the rest of your term? If it's already packed, creative writing or film keeps things balanced. If you've got room, statistics will pay off long after the course ends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but Dinner party tomorrow, ten people. I need background music that isn't awkward.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Aim for something warm and mostly instrumental, so it doesn't compete with conversation. Soul, bossa nova or mellow jazz usually works.
